newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SHC says court dismisses casino challenge.
newsitem.headline: SHC says court dismisses casino challenge.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd said on Thursday the High Court of Australia had dismissed the action by Kerry Packer to challenge the 1994 decision to award the Sydney casino licence to Sydney Harbour Casino (SHC).

Packer through a consortium, Darling Casino, lost a bidding war to SHC to receive the 12 year monopoly licence. But Packer snared management control of the casino when he paid A$240 million for the management rights in January this year.
"The Court dismissed Darling Casino Ltd's appeal against the awarding of the casino licence to Sydney Harbour Casino," the Sydney Harbour Casino said.
"This means the licence challenge is finally over," it said.
"It means the cloud which has been hanging over the casino licence for several years has now been removed," it said.
